news.title: ASX jumps, shrugging off weak consumer confidence, as oil prices fall
news.snippet: The Australian sharemarket had a strong session after US President Donald Trump said the Iran war “is effectively over”, boosting hopes for an end to the conflict that has driven up global energy costs.

news.title: Auric supercharges WA gold growth with 68Koz Iron Maiden deal
news.snippet: Auric Mining has struck a deal for the Iron Maiden gold project near Norseman, adding a historical 68,500-ounce resource and potential future feed for its Burbanks mill.

news.title: Who keeps crashing China’s sharemarket?
news.snippet: China is again in the midst of a sharemarket rout. The blame game has already begun.

news.title: Nvidia CEO’s fling will be an affair to remember for AI, and for Trump
news.snippet: Jensen Huang’s liaison with an alleged Chinese spy could cost Nvidia billions, set America’s AI sector back in its arms race with China, and embroil the US president.

news.title: Lindian lands 30Kt per annum Malawian rare earths offtake
news.snippet: Lindian Resources has secured an annual 30,000-tonne binding offtake for monazite concentrate from its Kangankunde rare earths project with a major global refiner.

news.title: Qantas to cut 850 local jobs as it shifts roles to India
news.snippet: A leading union said it was told by Qantas earlier in the year there was “no plan” to offshore any jobs. Qantas vigorously denies the claim.
